note: Three saved reviews (one tool name, openqodex-library-r1) of the three pull requests golden.json describes, in report.json's finding shape. golden.json is a golden file written for this fixture in Martian's shape; no Martian pull request is in it. benchmark/test/martian-board.test.mjs converts these reviews, and benchmark_data.json beside this file is what the converter writes for them. recorded/ holds what Martian's pipeline wrote for them with a stand-in judge.

findings.title: Coupon can be applied twice
findings.problem: The cart total is read before the discount lock is taken. Also, the refund handler logs the full card number.
findings.fix: Take the discount lock before reading the total, and mask the card number before logging.

findings.title: Discount lock taken after the total is read
findings.problem: The cart total is read before the discount lock is taken.
findings.consequence: One coupon can be applied twice.

findings.title: First page of orders is skipped
findings.problem: The pagination offset multiplies the page number without subtracting one.
findings.consequence: The first page of orders is never shown.
findings.fix: Subtract one from the page number before multiplying.

findings.title: Vague constant name
findings.consequence: A reader cannot tell what it holds.

outside_change.title: Archive migration loses rows
outside_change.problem: The migration deletes the archived ledger rows instead of moving them to the archive table, and no test covers the archive endpoint when the ledger is empty.
outside_change.consequence: Archived history is lost for good.
outside_change.fix: Move the rows in one transaction, and add a test for an empty ledger.
